name: bizcore-v260-emulator-tests
description: Firebase Emulator tests for BizCore V260 security rules, transactions and migration. Runs on your PC (needs Java 11+ and internet for the first emulator download).

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-bizcore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 rules-and-service.test.mjs invoices.test.mjs numbering.test.mjs migration-admin.test.mjs receipts.test.mjs accounts.test.mjs ledger.test.mjs purchases.test.mjs data-safety.test.mjs pricing-versions.test.mjs estimates.test.mjs job-costs.test.mjs running-totals.test.mjs users.test.mjs roles.test.mjs rights.test.mjs masters.test.mjs scope-v2716.test.mjs"
